issues.problem: Context 1 (僕たちは一蓮托生だ) and context 3 (社長と社員は一蓮托生の関係) could just as well take 一心同体 from the same set.
issues.action: Rewrote both so the shared outcome is explicit: 勝っても負けても…一蓮托生だ; 会社が傾けば社長も社員も一蓮托生だ.

issues.problem: Misuse 1 (新婚の二人は一蓮托生で、いつも仲がいい) is not clearly wrong: couples are commonly called 一蓮托生 in the sense of a shared fate.
issues.action: Replaced it with a clear meaning error (confusion with 一期一会: 旅先での出会いは一蓮托生だから大切にしたい) and a new reason.

issues.problem: Misuse 2 (百年に一人の、一世一代の天才) is closer to unusual than to clearly wrong; similar phrasings turn up in real writing.
issues.action: Replaced it with a clearly wrong trivial-occasion sentence (一世一代のカップラーメン) and a new reason.

issues.problem: Checked: 諸行無常 (Buddhist teaching, opening of the Heike), 勧善懲悪 (左伝 成公十四年 懲悪而勧善; Bakin's Hakkenden), 意気揚々 (史記 管晏列伝, Yanzi's driver), 一蓮托生 (Pure Land rebirth on one lotus), 一日千秋 (詩経 王風 采葛, 一日三秋), 一世一代 (actor's farewell performance in noh/kabuki).
issues.action: All kept unchanged. 神出鬼没 stays null because I am not sure of its origin.
